config_note: Re-measured 2026-08-25 after fixing throughput_avg_tps/itl_avg_ms, which were means of per-request rates: a request arriving in very few SSE chunks has a near-zero span, so its rate exploded and poisoned the mean (omlx on Qwen3-0.6B: 47 tokens in 3.0 chunks -> 8016 tok/s for a model whose bandwidth ceiling is ~330).
